Teacher Settings

Lock by date

When this is on, a door opens only on or after its date in December. Doors you missed over the weekend can be opened on Monday. When it is off, any door can be opened.

Team Mode

Split the class into teams. The team that answers correctly gets 1 point. Teams take turns.

Timer

Thinking time when you press Timer on a challenge.
